mapper.select: SELECT powers.power_id FROM users JOIN role_user ON users.user_id = role_user.user_id JOIN roles ON role_user.role_id = roles.role_id JOIN role_power ON roles.role_id = role_power.role_id JOIN powers ON role_power.power_id = powers.power_id WHERE users.user_name = #{user_name}

SELECT powers.power_id FROM users JOIN role_user ON users.user_id = role_user.user_id JOIN roles ON role_user.role_id = roles.role_id JOIN role_power ON roles.role_id = role_power.role_id JOIN powers ON role_power.power_id = powers.power_id WHERE users.user_token = #{user_token};

SELECT IF(COUNT(*) > 0, 1, 0) AS has_permission FROM users JOIN role_user ON users.user_id = role_user.user_id JOIN role_power ON role_user.role_id = role_power.role_id JOIN powers ON role_power.power_id = powers.power_id WHERE users.user_token = #{user_token} AND powers.power_name = #{power_name};
